knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A quality policy is a short statement of commitments, and the procedures underneath must support it.
An exclusion holds only while its stated reason still holds, so it must be reviewed when services change.
A measurable objective names a count or a comparison that can be checked over a period.

practicalCriteria: The learner writes a scope statement for a supplied service mix, with each exclusion carrying a reason.
The learner rewrites three supplied general aims as objectives, each with a measure, a date and an owner.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and refer any service the business is starting without a scope update.
Stop and refer any policy commitment that cannot be met by the current procedures.
